class AnthropicToolUseBlock(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    input: dict

@router.post("/canvas-operation")

    block: AnthropicToolUseBlock,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
    canvas_service: CanvasDocumentService = Depends(get_canvas_service)

    if block.name != "edit_canvas_document":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid tool block")

    canvas_id = block.input.get("canvas_id")

    if not canvas_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Missing canvas_id")

    updated_doc = await canvas_service.apply_operations(

An attacker can modify or overwrite documents owned by other workspaces by specifying their canvas_id in the tool use input.

corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/anthropic/agent/tools")

class AnthropicToolUseBlock(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    input: dict

@router.post("/canvas-operation")
async def execute_canvas_tool(
    block: AnthropicToolUseBlock,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_active_user),
    canvas_service: CanvasDocumentService = Depends(get_canvas_service)
):
    if block.name != "edit_canvas_document":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid tool block")

    canvas_id = block.input.get("canvas_id")
    operations = block.input.get("operations", [])

    if not canvas_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Missing canvas_id")

    doc = await canvas_service.get_canvas(canvas_id=canvas_id)
    if not doc or doc.workspace_id != current_user.workspace_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Canvas document not found")

    updated_doc = await canvas_service.apply_operations(
        canvas_id=canvas_id,
        operations=operations
    )
    return {
        "tool_use_id": block.id,
        "status": "success",
        "canvas_id": canvas_id,
        "version": updated_doc.version
    }
